decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series builds on the firm's long experience in formulating certified natural cosmetics, so it can interpret early results and refine the line, although the new male target group is somewhat farther from its core and there is no evidence of in-house research.
The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series and sits squarely within the firm's existing formulation knowledge, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and keep improving it.
